title: Analyzer data pipeline tests
description:
Add juce::UnitTest coverage for the phase-I analyzer data pipeline: PercentileCloud, HeadroomHistogram, ResonancePersistenceMap, StereoCoherenceData, and NoteRulerData per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.2–12.7, §18.3, §20, and §21.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/UI/PercentileCloud.* public APIs from i.1
- Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.* public APIs from i.2
- Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.*, StereoCoherenceData.*, NoteRulerData.* from i.3
- Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.* snapshot/push APIs from g.1
- tests/TestMain.cpp and existing tests/*Tests.cpp patterns (phases B–H)
- CMakeLists.txt as left by i.3 (tests/AnalyzerTests.cpp should already be listed — do not edit CMake unless the entry is missing)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.2–12.7 and §20 (percentiles, D(f), persistence map, headroom, coherence, note ruler, quality modes)

Implement tests/AnalyzerTests.cpp:
1. PercentileCloud: feed a known steady spectrum (constant bin values and/or engine-fed steady sine frames long enough to fill history) → Q10/Q50/Q90 converge near the constant within documented tolerance; D(f)=Q90-Q10 near 0 for steady tone; after setFrozen(true), further inputs do not change snapshot; setEnabled(false) remains safe.
2. Dynamic content: alternate low/high magnitude frames → Q90-Q10 (D(f)) widens versus steady case at exercised bins (ordering/inequality assert, not bit-identical).
3. HeadroomHistogram: push full-scale sine or square on L only → L peak ~0 dBFS, elevated L histogram mass near top bins; R quieter; mono between; crest factor finite and >1 for sine-like signals; clipped-count increments for deliberately overloaded samples (|x|>1).
4. ResonancePersistenceMap: inject persistent excess at one bin across many columns → map intensity forms a stable vertical structure (mean intensity at that bin across recent columns above neighbors); a brief burst does not dominate long-term column average the same way.
5. StereoCoherenceData: identical L=R signal → high correlation / low side energy; L=−R (or out-of-phase) → correlation drops / side energy rises (assert direction of change).
6. NoteRulerData: with a mocked/injected f0 (e.g. 110 Hz A2) current note labeling is plausible (A2 or enharmonic equivalence within API); markers API returns finite sorted frequencies; does not claim to mutate EQ parameters.
7. Quality/history bounds: prepare with Live vs Analysis style histories remains within fixed capacities (no growth after prepare); empty/disabled paths do not NaN.
8. Use juce::UnitTest; no new third-party test frameworks. Do not rewrite production analyzer modules solely to force green tests — only assert documented tolerances.
